## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `58de1f3e8c2e29530836c5cf6b90e0b58a33544e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: none (no published schema and no governed path in the file list; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green and the dev's `check-governed-merges --pr 34058` reads NOT governed) + `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` (the whole diff, +28 −4, one commit on merge-base `fb79d47c`; `main` has not touched this file since)

Inputs read: card #34003 body and its three comments (triage 6897219364, claim 6898241289, os-dev-report 6898462643); PR #34058 body, file list and net diff against `main`; the head's check-runs. Cited and read, not reviewed: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md` L13 and `references/lanes/review.md` 〈独立性与边界〉 on `main`.

Check-runs on this head: green — Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Auto Label, filter. Still running when read (13): Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Type Check · workspace / source gates / debt ledger / consumer gates, Plan Test Core shards. None red. The self-test figure (90 cases, 10 batteries) is the dev's statement; no CI job had confirmed it at read time, and this record did not run it.

### ① Derived judgments

- The bar is unchanged and still fails toward over-barring. `isBarred`, `seated`, `barred` and the returned state in `reviewSeatsOf` are byte-identical to the base; only the comment above `isBarred` moved. The taker text at the `review.barred` branch is untouched. `reportNotes` reads `reviewBarred` and returns strings; nothing it returns feeds `status`, `reviewSeat` or `taker`. No path in the diff frees a seat or waves a review through.
- The note matches its sources. `area-lease.md` L13 on `main`: 「复核席约每 3 活跃区一席,由他账号坐(`lanes/review.md`);同账号须维护者在该复核线程亲字。」 `lanes/review.md`: 「⛔ 不复核本账号派发或实现 PR,`area-lease.md` 例外」. `AREA_LEASE_BAR_NOTE` says: same-account seat is barred; under area-lease mode the maintainer may seat one by their own word in that seat's review thread; this tool reads GitHub only; read the thread before taking. That is the rule, no more: it names no field, label, comment line or other GitHub carrier, and claims no reading of the word. No carrier is invented.
- The card's Done-when is met by its second arm (output says so, with a pin) and its second bullet (the `isBarred` comment names the exception instead of calling the bar unconditional). The file surface in the claim (`check-owed-reviews.mjs` and its self-test) is not breached.
- `--json` consumers: none. Repo-wide grep at the head for `check-owed-reviews` outside the file finds prose in four `pm-dispatch` references, two jsdoc mentions in `record-recognisers.mjs`, one help string in `post-stamped.mjs`, and `package.json` `check:pm-record-recognisers`, which runs `--self-test` only. No workflow, script or package invokes `--json` or parses its document. The two in-file `--json` self-tests read `.rows[0]` by key, so a new top-level `notes` beside `rows` breaks neither. The change is additive.
- The pin reds if the note is dropped. The new case asserts, on two barred TAKE rows: `notes.length === 1` over `renderReport` lines containing `area-lease.md`, that line equal to the scales-prefixed `AREA_LEASE_BAR_NOTE`, and `reportNotes(barred).length === 1`. Removing the two `renderReport` lines, emptying `reportNotes`, or rewording the constant so it no longer names `area-lease.md` each fail it. It also pins the bar itself (`reviewSeat === 'barred'`, no seat named, lane seat as taker) and the no-barred-seat silence. Battery floor 16 → 17 matches one added case; no existing case was edited.
- should-fix S1: the `--json` wiring is not pinned. The pin covers the text report and `reportNotes`; nothing asserts that `main(... '--json' ...)` emits `notes`. Deleting `notes: reportNotes(rows)` from the `JSON.stringify` call leaves all 90 cases green, although the PR body presents `notes` as part of the fix. One assertion on the parsed document in the existing `--json` case closes it. Not blocking: the card's Done-when asks for the output statement and a pin, and the text report has both.
- nit N1: the usage text still reads 「--json prints the rows as JSON」; the document now also carries `notes` (and already carried `read` and `gaps`).
- nit N2: the header jsdoc says the report says so 「beside every barred seat」; the note prints once per report, below the rows, as the PR body and the pin both state.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the card's claim; consistent with the diff: `scripts/pm/**` is repo tooling, no package source, no published schema, no exported package API.
- `skip-changeset` label is on the PR and `Check Changeset` is green. Correct: nothing publishable changes.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` — correct, no metadata surface touched.
- No `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not governed: no `hits`; the Tier H floor and the queue guard do not bind this path.
- Single file, inside the claimed file surface; no skill, ADR, spec or workflow file in the diff.
- Independence, stated for the seat to settle and not judged here: `Reviewed-by` below is the session that claimed and dispatched card #34003 (comment 6898241289, account `os-steve`), and the PR's attribution login is `os-steve`. By the very rule this PR prints, that is a same-account review and stands only on the maintainer's own word in the review thread, which this record cannot see.
- Merge readiness is not asserted: 13 check-runs were still running at read time, including the job family that runs this file's self-test.

### ④ Design judgment

No `hits`, so no governed file to judge. On the implementing file: choosing the output route is the honest one. The maintainer's word lives in a project thread; a reader that guessed it from GitHub would turn a fail-closed bar into a fail-open one. One note per report, keyed off the rows' own `reviewBarred`, keeps text and JSON on a single pure source (`reportNotes`), and printing it above the INCOMPLETE block keeps the gap warning last before the footer. The note also fires when a third-account seat is seated beside a barred one, which is apt, since that row prints the barred seat too. Findings: S1, N1, N2 above; no must-fix.

Counts: must-fix 0 · should-fix 1 · nit 2

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-k62xqb`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmPd7uRqHauEehGPr19`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `36eda265ecacfca06c221b5d84a7eb97e8ef88fd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: none (no published schema and no governed path in the file list; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green on this head) + `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` (the whole diff against `main`, +30 −6, two commits on merge-base `fb79d47c`; `main` has not touched this file since)

Delta round on record 6898496953 (head `58de1f3e`). Inputs read: card #34003 body and its three comments (unchanged since round 1); PR #34058 body, file list and net diff against `main`; the delta `58de1f3e..36eda265` (one commit, +3 −3, same file); the new head's check-runs.

Check-runs on this head when read: green — Governed Surface Queue Guard. Still running (5): Check PR Size, PR-body guards, filter, Lint · ESLint, Type Check · consumer gates. Queued (10): Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Type Check · workspace / source gates / debt ledger. None red; Check Changeset had not reported yet on this head. No CI job has confirmed the self-test on this head, and this record did not run it.

### ① Derived judgments

Round-1 findings:

- S1 (the `--json` wiring unpinned) — CLOSED. The existing `--json` case now parses the document and asserts `Array.isArray(doc.notes)` and `JSON.stringify(doc.notes) === JSON.stringify(reportNotes(doc.rows))`. With `notes: reportNotes(rows)` deleted from the `JSON.stringify` call, `doc.notes` is undefined, `Array.isArray` is false and the case fails; a wiring that emitted some other value than the rows' own notes fails the equality. The mutant run the delta is said to have had is not in this review's inputs (no card or PR comment states it) and was not repeated here; the closure rests on reading the assertion.
- N1 (usage text) — CLOSED. The line now reads 「--json prints the rows and the report's notes (the area-lease note when a seat is barred) as JSON」, which is what the document carries.
- N2 (header jsdoc 「beside every barred seat」) — CLOSED. It now reads 「the report says so once whenever any row bars a seat」, which is what `renderReport` does and what the area-lease pin asserts.

The delta beyond those three lines: none. Round 1's judgments stand unchanged on this head, re-read against the net diff:

- The bar still fails toward over-barring: `isBarred`, the seated/barred split, the returned state and the taker text are identical to the base; `reportNotes` feeds no status, seat or taker.
- The note text is untouched by the delta and still matches `area-lease.md` L13 (「同账号须维护者在该复核线程亲字」) and `lanes/review.md` 〈独立性与边界〉 (「`area-lease.md` 例外」); it names no GitHub carrier.
- No consumer of `--json` exists outside the file (only `package.json` `check:pm-record-recognisers`, which runs `--self-test`); top-level `notes` is additive.
- The area-lease pin still fails if the note is dropped from the text report, if `reportNotes` is emptied, or if the constant stops naming `area-lease.md`. The delta adds no case and removes none: the battery floors are unchanged (review-seat battery 17), so the case count stays at the 90 the PR body states.

New on this head:

- nit N3: the PR body is stale against the head. 〈Tests〉 and 〈Verification〉 both cite head `58de1f3e` for the self-test and the 31 derived gates; neither names `36eda265`. 〈Tests〉 also says 「No existing test was edited」, which the delta made untrue: the existing `--json` case was strengthened (its old assertion is kept, two are added). Body-only; the seat patches it.
- nit N4: the `--json` pin exercises the empty case only. The fixture seats no review seat, so the document's `notes` is `[]`; a wiring that hard-coded an empty array would pass this case. The non-empty value is pinned on `reportNotes` and on the text report in the area-lease case, so only the composition through `main` with a barred row is unexercised. No effect on correctness.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged from round 1. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the card's claim, consistent with a diff confined to `scripts/pm/**`: no package source, no published schema, no exported package API.
- `skip-changeset` label is on the PR; correct, nothing publishable changes. `Check Changeset` had not yet reported on this head.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` — correct. No `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not governed: no `hits`; the Tier H floor and the queue guard do not bind this path.
- Single file, inside the claimed file surface (`check-owed-reviews.mjs` and its self-test); the delta stays inside it.
- Independence — round 1 flagged that `Reviewed-by` is the session that claimed and dispatched card #34003 on account `os-steve`, the PR's attribution login. The seat's answer, recorded as given and not judged by this reviewer: this record is the lane seat's own at-tier contract review, delegated to its isolated reviewer, and not a review-seat (`review#N`) review under area-lease mode; so the area-lease bar on same-account review seats does not apply to it. Whether a lane seat's delegated review satisfies the independence the contract-review rules ask for is read off those rules by the seat and the maintainer; the reviewer that rendered this record read only the inputs listed above.
- Merge readiness is not asserted: 15 check-runs were running or queued at read time, including the job family that runs this file's self-test.

### ④ Design judgment

No `hits`, so no governed file to judge. On the implementing file, the delta is the minimal closure of the three round-1 findings: one strengthened assertion in the case that already drove `main` with `--json`, and two wording corrections that bring the usage text and the header into agreement with the code. Tying the JSON pin to `reportNotes(doc.rows)` keeps text and JSON on the one pure source rather than restating the note. Findings: N3, N4 above; no must-fix, no should-fix.

Counts: must-fix 0 · should-fix 0 · nit 2

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-k62xqb`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmPd7uRqHauEehGPr19`

**VERDICT: PASS**
